privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
GrowWatch is a smart-greenhouse companion app operated by SL, a solo developer based in Denmark. This policy explains what data we collect, why, how long we keep it, and your rights under EU GDPR.

1. Data we collect
• Account: email address and a one-way hashed password. Email is also used to send verification links and password resets.
• Plants you add: name, type, planting date, count, custom code, and your action log (water, fertilize, prune, notes, etc.).
• Optional location: latitude and longitude you save in Settings, used only to fetch local weather and sunrise/sunset times.
• Sensor readings: temperature, humidity, light, pressure, and CO₂ values your ESP32 device sends. Stored in-memory for live use and as hourly aggregates in MongoDB.
• Settings: alert thresholds, notification preferences, locale.
• Push subscriptions: technical endpoint + keys issued by your browser, used to deliver push notifications. No personal content beyond what the notification itself contains.

2. Why we process it (lawful basis)
• Contract performance (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)) — running the app you signed up for.
• Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) — security logging, abuse prevention, transactional email delivery.
• Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) — push notifications (you opt in in Settings), location storage (you enter it).

3. Where it's stored
• Primary database: MongoDB Atlas.
• Backend hosting: Railway.
• Email delivery: Resend (EU/Ireland region).
• AI smart tips (Plus tier): Anthropic (Claude API).
• Weather data: Open-Meteo (no personal data, only lat/lng).
• Frontend hosting: Vercel; DNS: Porkbun via Cloudflare.

4. How long
• Account data is kept until you delete your account, after which it is permanently erased — including all plants, actions, reminders, sensor history, settings, push subscriptions, and tokens.
• Hourly sensor aggregates are kept as long as your account exists.
• Password-reset and email-verification tokens expire automatically (1 hour and 24 hours respectively).

5. Your rights
• Access: see your data in-app and request an export by email.
• Rectification: edit plants, settings, and email from the app.
• Erasure: delete your account from Settings → Danger zone (irrevocable).
• Portability: request a JSON export by email.
• Object/restrict: stop using the app, disable push, or contact us.
• Lodge a complaint: Datatilsynet (datatilsynet.dk) is the Danish data protection authority.

6. Children
GrowWatch is not intended for children under 13. If you are under 13, please do not sign up.

7. Security
Transport is HTTPS only. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Reset and verification tokens are stored as SHA-256 hashes. Database storage is encrypted at rest by MongoDB Atlas.

8. Contact
Questions or data requests: sergiiliuk@gmail.com.

9. Changes
We'll update the date at the top when this policy changes. Significant changes are notified by email.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
By creating a GrowWatch account or using the app, you agree to these terms.

1. The service
GrowWatch is a hobby-grade greenhouse monitoring app. Features include plant tracking, action logging, reminders, weather warnings, and (with Plus tier) AI-generated care tips. The service is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind.

2. Your account
• You're responsible for keeping your password secret.
• Don't share your account, attempt to access other people's data, or abuse the service.
• We may suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms.
• You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Danger zone.

3. Accuracy
GrowWatch is informational. Sensor data, weather forecasts, and AI care tips may be wrong, delayed, or unavailable. Don't rely on them for safety-critical decisions about your plants, especially valuable ones.

4. Subscription tiers
• Free: core features.
• Plus: AI smart tips and 3-day weather warnings.
• Pro: hardware-bundled features for users with an ESP32 sensor.
Features within each tier may change as the product evolves. Paid tiers are not yet available for online purchase — contact us if interested.

5. Hardware and third-party data
Weather data is provided by Open-Meteo. AI tips are generated by Anthropic's Claude API. We're not responsible for the accuracy or availability of these third-party services.

6. Liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, SL (the developer) is not liable for any loss of plants, data, time, or other damages arising from your use of GrowWatch.

7. Changes
We may update these terms. Significant changes will be notified by email. Continued use after a change means you accept the new terms.

8. Governing law
Danish law applies. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Danish courts.

9. Contact
sergiiliuk@gmail.com

seasonalTips.0: Protect tender perennials from frost — fleece on the coldest nights.
seasonalTips.1: Plan your spring sowing. Order seeds before stock runs low.
seasonalTips.2: Start tomatoes, peppers and basil indoors on a warm windowsill.
seasonalTips.3: Harden off seedlings — a week of daylight outdoors before planting out.
seasonalTips.4: After the last frost, plant out tender crops like courgettes and beans.
seasonalTips.5: Mulch beds to lock in moisture and slow weed growth.
seasonalTips.6: Water deeply in the early morning to reduce evaporation.
seasonalTips.7: Pinch out tomato side-shoots and keep harvesting basil to delay flowering.
seasonalTips.8: Save seeds from your healthiest plants for next year.
seasonalTips.9: Lift the last summer crops and compost spent foliage.
seasonalTips.10: Mulch beds for winter and clean tools before storing.
seasonalTips.11: Order next year's seeds and plan your crop rotation.

sensorSetup.title: Sensor setup guide
sensorSetup.heroBody: Follow these steps to connect your GrowWatch sensor to your home network.
sensorSetup.step1Body: Hold the BOOT button on your ESP32 for 3 seconds until the LED flashes blue. This puts it into setup mode.
sensorSetup.step2Body: Go to your phone's WiFi settings and connect to the network called GrowWatch-Setup. It will appear within a few seconds of step 1.
sensorSetup.step3Body: A setup page may open automatically. If nothing appears, open your browser and go to:
sensorSetup.step3Hint: http://192.168.4.1 — type this in your browser address bar
sensorSetup.step4Body: Select your home network from the list and enter your password. Tap Connect sensor. Your phone will disconnect from GrowWatch-Setup — that's normal.
sensorSetup.step4Hint: Sensor reboots automatically and connects to your home WiFi
sensorSetup.issue1A: Make sure you held BOOT for a full 3 seconds until the LED flashed.
sensorSetup.issue2A: Make sure your phone is still connected to GrowWatch-Setup, not your home WiFi.
sensorSetup.issue3A: Check your password and make sure your network is 2.4 GHz — the sensor doesn't support 5 GHz.
sensorSetup.changingWifiBody: Hold the BOOT button again for 3 seconds and repeat steps 2-4.
